title: ononis viscosa subsp. brachycarpa
intro: Ononis viscosa subsp. brachycarpa, commonly known as the sticky gorse or sticky wild gorse, is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ononis viscosa subsp. brachycarpa include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and alleviating fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
